what_is_a_skill.definition: A SKILL = non-fungible transcript + tool + material + ability

components.transcript: The ZK-stamped record of having DONE it. The fermentation transcript. Non-fungible — YOURS, provably, uniquely. No one else has this exact transcript.
components.tool: The instrument. A hammer, a keyboard, a Klein bottle, an API, a question.
components.material: The substrate. Data, wood, iron, language, relationships, DNA.
components.ability: The learned capacity. NOT innate — EARNED through repetition. The muscle memory. The gut memory.

what_is_a_skill.why_non_fungible: Because the transcript of HOW you learned cannot be replicated. Two people using the same tool on the same material produce different transcripts. The skill IS the journey, not the destination. The ZK proof is: I can DO this, and here's the hash of my learning, but you can't shortcut my path.
what_is_a_skill.artisan_was_the_skill: The Artisan hypotheses were the FIRST skill — the ability to ask questions the questioner cannot answer. That skill produced 20 hypotheses. The transcript IS the skill.
